description.value: Katsu Heaven is a Japanese cutlet restaurant in downtown Penticton specializing in tonkatsu-style dishes. It offers a focused menu of breaded cutlets in the Japanese tradition, making it a distinctive dining option in BC's Okanagan wine country. A touring cyclist passing through Penticton will find it a compact, sit-down spot a short roll from the main corridor through town.

The address matches OSM and the site shows a menu, gallery, and operating hours, confirming the business is real and open. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, leaving those fields null.
